column1: BY virtue of the powers vested in me by section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, the
Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education having obtained a report under Section 70C of the aforesaid
Act, in respect of "The American College of Higher Education (Private) Limited", a Company incorporated in Sri Lanka under
the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing Registration Number PV 7412 and located at No. 502, Peradeniya Road, Kandy, do
by this Order subject to such conditions as specified in Schedule I hereto, recognize "The American College of Higher Education
(Private) Limited" as a Degree Awarding Institute for the purpose of developing Higher Education therein, leading to the award
of the Degree specified in Column I of the Schedule II hereto, of which the abbreviation is set out in the corresponding entry in
Column II of the Schedule II hereto:-
